title: MUSIC-type Imaging for Anomaly Detection Using Scattering Parameter Data Without a Switching Device
core_idea: Design a MUSIC-type imaging function that uses scattering parameter (S-parameter) data to locate small anomalies in microwave imaging without requiring a switching device, and analyze its mathematical structure and sensitivity to antenna configurations to guide antenna arrangement.
tldr: Propose and mathematically analyze a MUSIC-based imaging approach that detects small anomalies from scattering parameter measurements without a switching device, focusing on how antenna configuration affects imaging performance and suggesting suitable arrangements.
